name: Heroku Code MCP
description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for searching and executing Heroku Platform API operations.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public app origin, for example https://your-app.herokuapp.com. Used for endpoint metadata and OAuth callback defaults.

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Shared secret required to call /mcp and OAuth start/status endpoints. Send as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY_BASE64.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte key for encrypting OAuth tokens. Generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))"

WRITE_CONFIRMATION_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign write confirmation tokens.

HEROKU_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Heroku OAuth client ID. Required for /oauth/start and execute calls.

HEROKU_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Heroku OAuth client secret. Required for /oauth/start and execute calls.
